clips.title: The story
paras: Lady Sarevess is a twisted naga sorceress dwelling within the flooded ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, where she dabbles in dark sorceries.

Within the Pool of Ask'ar, Lady Sarevess conducts her rituals in a flooded grotto of the ruined temple. A very twisted spellcaster, she dabbles in dark magic while the Twilight's Hammer cultists who also haunt the sunken temple pursue their own worship deeper in the cavern.

Much like a sea witch of the deep oceans, Sarevess commands elemental currents and crackling arcs of lightning. Surrounded by loyal naga sentinels and summoned water elementals, she fiercely defends her sanctuary against any intruders who threaten her dark work.
